de: Grand Master António Manoel de Vilhena lays down the first stone of Fort Manoel in Malta.

de: Morean War: the Battle of Kalamata ends in a Venetian victory over the forces of the Ottoman Empire under the Kapudan Pasha.

dz: 高尔主教学校(Bishop Gore School)是威尔士最古老的学校之一,是创办所.

t: 霍米尔登山战役(Battle of Homildon Hill):默多克·斯图尔特(英语:Mu…

dz: 霍米尔登山战役(Battle of Homildon Hill):默多克·斯图尔特(英语:Murdoch Stewart, Duke of Albany and Archibald)手下的一支入侵苏格兰军队,厄尔·道格拉斯被一支由乔治,马克伯爵和亨利·珀西(英语:Henry Percy, 1st Earl of Northumberland)指挥的由500名英格兰弓箭手组成的分队所歼灭.
de: Battle of Homildon Hill: An invading Scottish army under Murdoch Stewart, Duke of Albany and Archibald, Earl Douglas is decimated by a contingent of 500 English archers under the command of George, Earl of March and Henry Percy, 1st Earl of Northumberland.

dz: 一支由皇后玛蒂尔达所组成的军队击败并驱散了一支被温彻斯特包围的皇后玛蒂尔达所组成的军队. 格洛斯特的罗伯特被俘获并交换给王后玛蒂尔达的丈夫斯蒂芬.
de: An army of queen Matilda defeats and disperses an army of empress Matilda which was besieging Winchester. Robert of Gloucester is captured and exchanged for king Stephen, husband of queen Matilda.

dz: 巴达斯·普克斯(Bardas Phokas) 反抗拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世并宣布自己为皇帝.

dz: "三部曲之夜":哈伦·拉希德(Harun al-Rashid)在弟弟哈迪(al-Hadi)去世后成为了阿拔斯哈里发. 哈伦的儿子al-Ma'mun的出世.
